Muscle Growth Peptides

This category holds the muscle growth compounds in our catalog, from IGF-1, MGF and the Wolverine Stack to Tesamorelin and Ipamorelin, each labeled for research use only and shipped from the USA and Canada to addresses across the United States.

Wholesale and bulk

Shop by category

This group shares most of its products with growth hormone peptides, where CJC-1295, Ipamorelin, GHRP-2, GHRP-6, Tesamorelin and AOD-9604 are covered in detail. What sets it apart are two growth factors, IGF-1 and MGF, both on WADA's list of growth factors banned at all times, and one blend, the Wolverine Stack.8 Muscle growth is the catalog's name for the group, not a result that any source behind this page reports.

For sport-related research, one change matters. WADA's 2027 Prohibited List, approved on September 10, 2026, adds "peptides" to the examples in class S0, the unapproved substances banned at all times.12 The 2026 list already bans thymosin beta-4 derivatives such as TB-500 as growth factors and lists BPC-157 under S0, so both components of the Wolverine Stack are on the list.8 The muscle goal guide maps the published research by compound.

Frequently asked questions

Where can I buy the Wolverine stack?

The Wolverine Stack is in this category: one vial holding BPC-157 and TB-500, with the amount of each shown on its product page. Blends draw regulatory attention: in August 2026 warning letters, FDA called two other sellers' blends unapproved new drugs, including one described as tesamorelin 10 mg plus ipamorelin 3 mg.34 For prescription drugs, FDA allows a fixed combination only when each component contributes to the claimed effects and each component's dosage keeps the combination safe and effective for the patients its labeling defines.5 BPC-157 and TB-500 are also sold as single vials.

Can CJC-1295 and Ipamorelin help with muscle growth?

No source behind this page reports a trial of the pair for muscle growth, so this page makes no such claim. The record that does exist concerns sport and safety. WADA's 2027 Prohibited List, in force from January 1, 2027, still names CJC-1295 and ipamorelin in class S2.12 The combined vial is CJC-1295 + Ipamorelin, listed outside the categories, and FDA's safety notes on each compound are summarized on growth hormone peptides.

What is the regulatory status of MGF?

FDA lists mechano growth factor (MGF) in 503A Category 3, which means it was nominated for pharmacy compounding without adequate support.6 A different, pegylated form, PEG-MGF, is on FDA's list of substances once in Category 2 whose nominations were withdrawn, and FDA says it has not identified any human exposure data on drug products that contain it.7 WADA's 2026 list bans mechano growth factors at all times as growth factors.8 The MGF education page covers the published research and its limits.
